summary: Advanced Drainage Systems filed a routine Form 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing unaudited fiscal Q2 results ended September 30, 2026 (Item 2.02), Regulation FD slides and conference-call details for CEO Scott Barbour and CFO Scott Cottrill (Item 7.01), and notice of a Board-approved $0.20 per share quarterly cash dividend payable December 15, 2026 to holders of record December 1, 2026 (Item 8.01). No acquisition, divestiture, tender, review, or management departure is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary earnings and capital-return update with no deal terms and no arbitrage angle to monitor.
